prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign in to keep your pet safely backed up", "Already created a pet? Signing in restores your existing companion and saves all your progress across devices.", "Use your primary email to retrieve previous pets automatically."]
1: ["Setting up desktop overlay...", "Your pet is getting ready to land on your screen. If your desktop is crowded, check your system tray."]
2: ["Refine Your Custom Companion Visuals", "Upload Photo", "For best results, use well-lit photos with clear lighting."]
3: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Pick an instant starter companion or create a customized custom desktop pet."]
4: ["Click your desktop tray icon anytime to minimize, hide, or customize your companion."]
5: ["Verify Companion Appearance", "Review your companion's design and expression before final placement."]
6: ["Having trouble? Select passwordless magic link to sign in without stalling."]
7: ["System Tray & Desktop Controls", "Learn how to toggle pet visibility and change desktop sound settings from your system tray."]
8: ["Preparing desktop environment assets and window overlays..."]
9: ["You can change or add more pets later at any time from the app settings."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal contact information by requesting the user's primary email.
Asks for personal information by prompting the user to upload photos.
Creates urgency and pressures the user by telling them to sign in without stalling.
